تنتظمون (form VIII)
# تَنْتَظِمُونَ (tantaẓimūna) /tan.ta.ðˤi.muː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِنْتَظَمَ (intaẓama)
# تُنْتَظَمُونَ (tuntaẓamūna) /tun.ta.ðˤa.muː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِنْتَظَمَ (intaẓama)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
